camel_example: aliyun smc CreateWorkgroup --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key TestKey --Description test --Tag.1.Value TestValue --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000' --Name testWorkgroupName
description_en: Workgroups are used to manage the lifecycle of multiple migration tasks in batch server migration scenarios
description_zh: 工作组可以同时管理多个迁移任务的生命周期，适用于需要批量迁移服务器的场景
kebab_example: aliyun smc create-workgroup --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --name testWorkgroupName --description test --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateWorkgroup

parameters.help_en: A token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value from your client that contains up to 64 ASCII characters. This ensures that retried requests are idempotent. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。您可以从客户端生成一个不超过64个ASCII字符的参数值，并将值赋予ClientToken，保证重试请求的幂等性。更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The name of the workgroup. The name must meet the following requirements:

The workgroup name must be unique.

The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, colons (:), periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
工作组名称。名称需满足以下要求：

任务名称必须唯一。
长度为2~64个英文或中文字符，必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头，可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、点号（.）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the workgroup. It must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: 工作组描述。长度为 2～256 个英文或中文字符，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

fields.help_en: The tag key. It can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot be an empty string. The key cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 工作组的标签键。最多支持128个字符，一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. It can be up to 128 characters in length and can be an empty string. The value cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 工作组的标签值。最多支持128个字符，一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: An array of tags. The array can contain 1 to 20 tags. If the array contains multiple tags, the value of \`Key\` for each tag must be unique
parameters.help_zh: 标签数组。数组长度：1~20。如果数组中有多个标签对象，标签键Key不允许重复
parameters.name: tag
